no_findings_reason: NOT REVIEWED — the finding set is empty because no review produced one, not because a review produced none. The self-review gate ran on release/16.4.0 three times, once per branch head, and went NEUTRAL every time with one identical cause: the Anthropic API refused every chunk with HTTP 400 `invalid_request_error` / `Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API. Please go to Plans & Billing to upgrade or purchase credits.` Runs and heads: 38064860966 (1789f6bf8), 38065950151 (2bb56e492), 38088832033 (7af9d1568). In each, job `live-advisory`, step `Dogfooded self-review`, reported transport `api (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)` and then `chunk N/6 did not complete` for all six chunks, closing with `self-review-gate NEUTRAL — no chunk completed, nothing was reviewed, not a blocker` (first request_id of the last run: req_011CfuHkG3kbq97cdTVYD7Gm). The upload step then ran with `if-no-files-found: ignore` and logged `No files were found with the provided path: /tmp/self-review-findings.json. No artifacts will be uploaded.`, so `Build the findings ledger` logged `no findings artifact for 16.4.0 — nothing to ingest` and `Commit the findings ledger` logged `no ledger was built for 16.4.0 — nothing to commit`. HAVE_RELEASE_PR_TOKEN was true and the key was present: this is a BILLING exhaustion, not a missing secret and not a prompt-size failure, which distinguishes it from the 14.17.0–14.19.0 run of nulls (those were `prompt is too long`). It is also NOT chronic here: 16.1.0, 16.2.0 and 16.3.0 each carry a single-pass reviewed ledger with 49, 20 and 45 findings, so the gate worked on the three preceding releases and stopped working on this one. Nothing in this repository can fix it — restoring the API credit balance is the whole remedy, and until it is restored 16.5.0 reproduces this exactly. Falsifiable: if any of the three runs is shown to contain a completed model call, or an artifact or `release-findings-json` machine block for 16.4.0 is produced, this reason is wrong and the ledger must be re-ingested. Recorded 2026-10-11; the three runs cited above all ran 2026-10-10. Written while unblocking the 16.4.0 release at release.ts step 7, which refuses to merge and tag with no ledger.
